findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no ACL restricting access, exposing stored data (including the customer master file) to unauthenticated or unintended access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.
A sensitive file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to a bucket that is public and unencrypted, directly exposing customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving it unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored operations data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored data science data unencrypted at rest.
